story.label: Our story
story.heading: Why HyperQuote exists
story.p1: Egyptian construction runs on relationships, phone calls, and handshake deals. Contractors spend days calling suppliers for prices, comparing quotes on paper, and coordinating deliveries with no visibility. There's no standard platform, no price transparency, and no way to track an order once it's placed.
story.p2: HyperQuote replaces that chaos with a structured, transparent system while preserving the relationship-driven way Egyptian business works. We source from multiple suppliers, consolidate pricing, handle logistics, and give every stakeholder real-time visibility into the process.
story.p3: Based in Cairo, HyperQuote works with supplier networks across Egypt and supports professional procurement teams from sourcing through delivery.

value1.title: Quotes
value1.description: Submit your material list and receive a single consolidated quote from multiple suppliers. No more days spent chasing individual prices.

value2.title: Order tracking
value2.description: Every quote includes unit pricing, delivery timelines, and payment terms. Track your order from confirmation through delivery with live GPS.

value3.title: Local operations
value3.description: Designed for how Egyptian construction actually works. Quote-based pricing, wire and cheque payments, Cairo truck ban compliance, ETA e-invoicing — all built in.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, phone number, company name, and any messages you send through our platform. We also collect usage data such as pages visited, features used, and device information to improve our services.

usage.title: Data Usage
usage.content: Your data is used to process quote requests, coordinate deliveries, communicate with you about your orders, and improve our platform. We may use your contact information to send service-related updates. We never sell your personal data to third parties.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.content: Your data is stored securely on servers within the Middle East and North Africa region. We use industry-standard encryption for data in transit and at rest. Data is retained for the duration of your account and for a reasonable period thereafter as required by Egyptian commercial law.

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.content: We share your information with suppliers only to the extent necessary to fulfill your quote requests and orders. Supplier identity is disclosed but pricing details between HyperQuote and suppliers are never shared with customers. We may share data with law enforcement when required by Egyptian law.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You may request a copy of all data we hold about you. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@hyperquote.net. We will respond within 30 days as required by Egyptian data protection regulations.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For privacy-related inquiries, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@hyperquote.net or write to: HyperQuote, Arkan Plaza, Sheikh Zayed, Egypt.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using the HyperQuote platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, you must not use the platform. These terms apply to all users, including contractors, suppliers, and visitors.

services.title: Services
services.content: HyperQuote provides a digital platform for sourcing building materials in Egypt. We connect contractors with verified suppliers, facilitate the quoting process, and coordinate deliveries. HyperQuote acts as the seller of record for all transactions. Prices are provided through quotes and are not published publicly.

obligations.title: User Obligations
obligations.content: You agree to provide accurate information when creating an account and submitting quote requests. You must not use the platform for any unlawful purpose. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. Commercial use of pricing data obtained through the platform is prohibited.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: HyperQuote provides the platform on an as-is basis. While we strive to ensure accurate pricing and timely delivery, we are not liable for supplier delays, price fluctuations, or force majeure events. Our total liability is limited to the value of the specific transaction in question.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt. Any disputes arising from the use of the platform shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Cairo, Egypt. The Arabic version of these terms is the legally binding document.

amendments.title: Amendments
amendments.content: HyperQuote reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the modified terms. Material changes will be communicated via email or platform notification.

support.heading: How can we help?
support.heroBody: Tell us what you need. We usually reply within a few hours.
support.formSubheading: We'll get back to you within a few hours.

1.question: How long does it take to receive a quote?
1.answer: Submit your material list through the platform. We source pricing from multiple suppliers in parallel during business hours (Sunday–Thursday, 8 AM–6 PM). Each quote includes unit pricing, delivery timeline, and payment terms. You can accept, negotiate quantities, swap materials, or request changes from your dashboard.

2.question: When can you deliver within Greater Cairo?
2.answer: Most Cairo orders arrive within 24–48 hours. Heavy materials (steel, cement, aggregates) are delivered during permitted hours due to the Cairo truck ban that restricts heavy vehicles between 6 AM and midnight. Every delivery includes real-time GPS tracking and SMS status updates.

3.question: What payment methods do you accept?
3.answer: Wire transfers, post-dated cheques, cash on delivery, and letters of credit. We follow Egyptian B2B standards — no online payments or mobile wallets. All invoices include 14% VAT and are ETA e-invoicing compliant. Payment terms are negotiable for established accounts.

4.question: How do I sign up?
4.answer: Enter your Egyptian mobile number and verify it first. Add your company name and full name to complete registration. Email/password is optional during account setup and only works after the email is confirmed.

5.question: What building materials do you supply?
5.answer: Over 500 products across cement, reinforcing steel, aggregates, bricks, ceramic tiles, timber, insulation, plumbing, electrical, paint, and waterproofing. All sourced from verified Egyptian suppliers. The catalog shows price ranges and specifications — exact pricing is calculated per quote based on quantity and delivery location.

6.question: Do you deliver outside Cairo?
6.answer: Yes — Alexandria, the Delta, and Upper Egypt. Delivery takes 24–72 hours depending on distance. Remote locations may require minimum order quantities. Contact us for a delivery estimate to your specific construction site.

7.question: How does invoicing work?
7.answer: Every order generates an Arabic e-invoice compliant with the Egyptian Tax Authority's real-time system. Invoices break down 14% VAT, itemized materials, delivery charges, and payment terms. Available in your dashboard and sent via email and WhatsApp automatically.

8.question: Do you offer volume pricing for large projects?
8.answer: Yes. Bulk orders get priority pricing from our supplier network. For projects exceeding EGP 500,000, we assign a dedicated account manager who handles quoting, delivery scheduling across multiple sites, and consolidated invoicing.

9.question: What is your returns policy?
9.answer: Defective or incorrect materials can be returned within 7 days of delivery. We arrange pickup at no extra cost. Custom-cut items and special orders are non-returnable unless defective. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after inspection.

10.question: Is the platform fully available in Arabic?
10.answer: Arabic is our primary language. Every screen, invoice, and document uses native right-to-left layout. Numbers display in Arabic-Indic numerals (١٢٣) when using Arabic. You can switch between Arabic and English at any time from the header.
